title: Exquisite Elegant Norwegian Salmon Skewers
description: A romantic Norwegian dish featuring miso-marinated salmon, white chocolate chips, and a funky twist, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, brown sugar, soy sauce, and lemon juice to make the marinade.
Add the salmon pieces to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated salmon onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with garlic powder.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the salmon is cooked through.
Melt the white chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Serve the grilled salmon skewers with melted white chocolate drizzled on top.
